title: 第7章 传奇恶魔的阴影第8章 朋友
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 上一秒，才谈论那只传奇恶魔，下一秒就碰到正主。
这并不是偶然。
至少，这已经是林鬼这两天，遇到的第3只传奇恶魔了......
林鬼的眼神都快失去焦点了。
第一只是，摩拉格·萨恩，又称作腐语先知，是一只传奇树魔。
严格来说，它不是黑魔森林的，而是格伦山地的。
在林鬼察觉到黑魔森林的暴动，打算撤回去的时候，撞到了。
就此林鬼打消了撤退的想法。
摩拉格·萨恩的实力已经无限接近于史诗，这已经超过了他能力范围。
第二只是，戈洛格·铁颚，又称作铸铁君王，是一只传奇石怪。
铸铁君王是一只元素恶魔，和其他恶魔不同，它长年陷入沉睡。
林鬼路过的时候，还从他身边顺走了几个块掉落的石头。
而这第三只......
就是希娅想要讨伐的传奇恶魔。
林渊噬喰者——莫拉格斯。
林鬼冷汗从脸颊流下，而一旁站着的希娅面色有几分纠结。
“快走吧，我们才认识不过10多分钟，你没有必要救我。”
传奇恶魔的出动往往带着恶魔潮。
就在希娅说出哪个传奇恶魔名字后，四周已经被恶魔围住了。
不用感知，林鬼耳边能听到恶魔的嗤嗤声。
那是恶魔爬行的声响，越来越近，越来越密集。
“欸，好吧。“希娅叹了口气，语气带着几分惋惜。
“和你聊天很愉快，有什么遗言需要我传达的吗？“
她确实有能力带着林鬼逃走，但这会大大降低她自己存活的概率。
作为一名刀口舔血的冒险家，她不会这么做。
哪怕带上对方，只降低自己3点存活率
林鬼平静地回答。
“快走吧，没有遗言。孑然一身，无亲无故，就让我独自死在这里吧。“
“名字？”
“林鬼。”
“古怪的名字……我会记住你的，林鬼。“
说完，希娅脚步一蹬。
眨眼间，淹没进茂密的树林中。
只要不是传奇恶魔亲自追击，她有很大把握甩掉追兵。
见话痨精灵消失，林鬼长舒一口气。
幽夜纱衣是他的心血之作。
content_en:
One second, they were talking about the legendary demon, and the next second, they met the real owner.
This is no accident.
At least, this is the third legendary demon Lin Gui has encountered in the past two days...
Lin Gui's eyes almost lost focus.
The first is that Molag Sarn, also known as the Prophet of Rot, is a legendary tree demon.
Strictly speaking, it is not from the Dark Demon Forest, but from the Glen Mountains.
When Lin Gui noticed the riot in the Dark Forest and was about to retreat, he bumped into it.
At this point, Lin Gui gave up the idea of ​​​​retreating.
Morag Thanh's strength is infinitely close to epic, which is beyond the scope of his capabilities.
The second one is, Gorog Ironjaw, also known as the Iron King, is a legendary stone monster.
The Iron King is an elemental demon. Unlike other demons, it has been asleep for many years.
When Lin Gui passed by, he also took a few fallen stones away from him.
And this third one...
It's the legendary demon that Shia wants to defeat.
The Ghoul Eater of Lin Yuan - Moragos.
Lin Gui's cold sweat flowed down his face, while Xia standing aside looked a little confused.
"Come on, we've only known each other for more than 10 minutes, there's no need for you to save me."
The dispatch of legendary demons often brings a wave of demons.
Just after Shia said the name of the legendary demon, she was surrounded by demons.
Without any sense, Lin Gui could hear the devil's chirping sound in his ears.
It was the sound of demons crawling, getting closer and closer.
"Eh, okay." Sia sighed, with a bit of regret in her tone.
"It was a pleasure chatting with you. Do you have any last words for me to convey?"
She does have the ability to escape with the Lin Kuei, but this would greatly reduce her own chance of survival.
As a risk-taking adventurer, she wouldn't do that.
Even if you bring the opponent with you, it will only reduce your own survival rate by 3 points.
Lin Kuei replied calmly.
"Let's go quickly. I have no last words. I am alone and have no relatives or friends. Let me die here alone."
"Name?"
"Lin Gui."
"Weird name... I'll remember you, Lin Kuei."
After saying that, Xia stepped forward.
In the blink of an eye, it was submerged into the dense woods.
As long as the legendary demon didn't pursue her personally, she had a high degree of confidence in getting rid of her pursuers.
Seeing the chatterbox elf disappear, Lin Gui let out a long sigh of relief.
Youye Shayi is his painstaking work.
